title: Signal
description: A named, versioned, defined condition observable in the record.

description.description: One paragraph in plain language, no jargon, no verdict.

id.description: Identifier from STANDARDS.md (e.g. 'S.2' for the STOCK Act row).

citation.description: Verbatim citation string for display (e.g. 'STOCK Act of 2012, Pub. L. 112–105').

criteria.description: The condition, in prose. The reference implementation is linked from the corresponding docs/signals/<slug>.md file.

not_saying.description: Explicit paragraph naming the interpretations this Signal does NOT support. Required.

supersedes.description: The Signal ID this version supersedes, when applicable.

fixture.description: Path to the fixture data used in the example.

expected.description: Description of the expected Finding(s), or the expected null result.

implementation.description: SHA-256 of each file that makes this version what it is: the whole definition file, the implementation that writes its Findings, its reference implementation where one exists, and its known-answer cases. Written by src/signals/run.py, never typed. The code is part of the criteria (METHODOLOGY.md §3.2), so a published version's row, these hashes included, never changes; a change to any of these files is a new version (INVARIANTS.md §11).
